courses.title: Coaching and Mentoring Engineering Leads
courses.description: Coaching and Mentoring Engineering Leads focuses on coaching and mentoring leads for people working toward a Data Engineering Lead role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces cloud data platforms, enough to apply alongside coaching and mentoring leads in real Data Engineering Lead work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to coaching and mentoring leads and show how cloud data platforms supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying coaching and mentoring leads to a real Data Engineering Lead scenario
Practicing coaching and mentoring leads through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to cloud data platforms
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: ETL Design for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of etl design, for people already working toward a Data Engineering Lead role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in etl design and want to go further.
